about_the_game:
"We shouldn’t be here."

“Screaming In The Basement” is a psychological thriller from the first person, the game takes place in apartment. inspired by P.T.

Average time to complete the game: 120 minutes

WARNING:

Epileptic seizures associated with increased sensitivity to light are Possible. Some people may experience seizures when exposed to flashes of light and flashing images that appear in a video game. People who have not previously experienced such attacks may not be aware of their illness. A reasonable restriction of the game audience is recommended.

Mike is the main character, a journalist driven by a thirst for uncovering deep, hidden truths. His character is shaped by a complex mix of curiosity and resilience. He gains access to an apartment where, according to locals, restless souls are said to haunt the place—a fact that still needs to be confirmed, tied to a terrible incident. A family consisting of a father, mother, and daughter once lived in the apartment and were killed by someone whose identity remains unknown.

In 1990, a family bought a house in Russia from Robert. After hearing strange noises from the basement and rumors of a curse, they left and moved to New York, they rented apartment from Norman Harold.

Do you have the courage to face the nightmare and uncover the truth behind that fateful night?

What awaits you:

  • The main genre of the game is "Walking Simulator";

  • Uncover the truth behind the rumored supernatural occurrences.

  • Gameplay closely mirrors reality;

  • Isolated feeling – You’re alone in the environment, with no one to help, heightening the sense of vulnerability.

  • Explore different rooms, observing subtle shifts in the environment.

  • Be accompanied by natural environmental sounds that enhance the feeling of presence and gradually lead you into madness.

  • Paranormal Activity: Objects move and environments change mysteriously.

  • Feel free to explore at your own pace; you never know what hidden secrets, notes, or clues you might discover.

  • The plot progresses through the player's recordings and decisions.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains images of scenes of violence that can have a negative impact on the psyche. Some content items may not be suitable for certain age categories. A reasonable restriction of the game audience is recommended.

short_description: Inspired by P.T. A journalist called "Mike" investigates a tragic family murder linked to a cursed apartment in Chicago. Unsettling mysteries surround a deadly incident from 1991, and while restless souls are said to haunt the place, this remains unconfirmed.
